Overview

Port Elizabeth is a city in Eastern Cape with a population of 1,263,000. The Friendly City on Algoa Bay, known for its beaches, automotive industry, and outdoor adventure opportunities. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
